preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Prepare the anaerobic DSMZ Medium 212 formulation with the DSM 2805
    final carbon sources, Na-propionate and D-Glucose, under an 80% N2 and 20% CO2
    atmosphere.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dispense the basal solution under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes and autoclave; autoclave carbonate, carbon-source, cysteine, and sulfide
    solutions separately under anoxic gas.
- step_number: 3
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare the seven-vitamins solution under 100% N2 and sterilize it
    by filtration.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Add the sterile supplement solutions to sterile anoxic basal medium
    after autoclaving.
- step_number: 5
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust the complete medium to pH 7.2 if necessary.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Add and dissolve ingredients of solution A and sparge medium with 80%
    N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium
    under the same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes and autoclave. Solution
    B is prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere and autoclaved. Solutions
    C, E and F are autoclaved under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Solution D is prepared
    under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. To complete the medium appropriate
    amounts of solutions B to F are added to the sterile solution A in the sequence
    as indicated. Adjust pH of complete medium to 7.2, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: 'Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates
    growth at the beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete
    medium from a sterile anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically
    1 - 2 ml of the recommended freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and
    incubate for 3 - 5 days . After incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell
    suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with liquid medium.'
- step_number: 3
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve
    the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.

    gas and sterilized by filtration. To complete the medium appropriate amounts of
    solutions B to I are added to the sterile solution A in the sequence as indicated.

  action: MIX
  description: 'Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates
    growth at the beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete
    medium from a sterile anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically
    1 - 2 ml of the recommended freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and
    incubate for 3 - 5 days . After incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell
    suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with liquid medium.'
- step_number: 3
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve
    the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
- step_number: 5
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 0.1 ml of vitamin K1 in 20 ml 95% ethanol and filter sterilize.
    Store refrigerated in a brown bottle.

1. Add and dissolve ingredients of solution A and sparge medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO

2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium under the same gas
atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes and autoclave. Solution B is prepared under
80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere and autoclaved. Solutions C, E and F are autoclaved
under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Solution D is prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized
by filtration. To complete the medium appropriate amounts of solutions B to F are added to
the sterile solution A in the sequence as indicated. Adjust pH of complete medium to 7.2, if
necessary.

2. Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates growth at the
beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete medium from a sterile
anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically 1 - 2 ml of the recommended
freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and incubate for 3 - 5 days . After
incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with
liquid medium.


For DSM 2805: Replace butyrate with 1.50 g/l Na-propionate and supplement medium with
1.00 g/l D-glucose added from a sterile anoxic stock solution sterilized by filtration.

For DSM 4212: Replace Na-butyrate in solution C with 0.61 g Na-stearate. Adjust the
amount of distilled water in solution C to 20 ml. Dissolve stearate in water by heating in a
water bath.

For DSM 16706: Replace butyrate with 1.50 g/l Na-propionate.

For DSM 26217: Omit butyrate and add to the complete medium 7.00 g/l sucrose from a
sterile anoxic stock solution.

For DSM 102352: Replace butyrate with 2.00 g/l Na-benzoate.
